description: This file defines the class JSONRequestBodyMapHandler, which implements RequestBodyMapHandler to extract a Map<String, Object> from JSON data in an HTTP request body.

classes.name: JSONRequestBodyMapHandler
classes.description: A class capable of parsing JSON from a ServletRequest input stream into a Map<String, Object>.

methods.name: extractMapFromRequestBody
methods.description: Extracts a Map<String, Object> from the JSON data in the request body, casting it appropriately.
